if (a) { var href = a.getAttribute('href') || ''; if (href.charAt(0) === '?') { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); var m = /[?&]query=([^&]+)/.exec(href); if (m) { var q = decodeURIComponent(m[1].replace(/\+/g, ' ')); var blk = a.closest('li,p,td,div') || document.body; var w = blk.cloneNode(true); w.querySelectorAll('rt,rp').forEach(function (n) { n.remove(); }); dsm.tap(q, w.textContent.trim()); } return; } } // A tap on a glossary image (or a collapsed image's [Image] toggle) is not a lookup. if (e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.gloss-image-link, .gloss-image-summary')) return; var r = document.caretRangeFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY); if (!r || r.startContainer.nodeType !== 3) return; var node = r.startContainer, off = r.startOffset; if (node.parentElement.closest('rt,rp')) return; if (off > 0) { var p = document.createRange(); p.setStart(node, off - 1); p.setEnd(node, off); var b = p.getBoundingClientRect(); if (e.clientX >= b.left && e.clientX <= b.right && e.clientY >= b.top && e.clientY <= b.bottom) off--; } if (off >= node.textContent.length) return; // Latin words are looked up from their first letter (a tap on "running"'s n sends "running"). while (off > 0 && /[A-Za-z0-9\u00C0-\u024F'\u2019]/.test(node.textContent.charAt(off - 1)) && /[A-Za-z0-9\u00C0-\u024F]/.test(node.textContent.charAt(off))) off--; var block = node.parentElement.closest('li,p,td,div') || document.body; var range = document.createRange(); range.setStart(node, off); range.setEnd(block, block.childNodes.length); var after = range.cloneContents(); after.querySelectorAll('rt,rp').forEach(function (n) { n.remove(); }); var whole = block.cloneNode(true); whole.querySelectorAll('rt,rp').forEach(function (n) { n.remove(); }); dsm.tap(after.textContent.substring(0, 64), whole.textContent.trim()); }); </script>"""

// Our note type bolds the word; other note types (Anime Cards, Lapis...) get the sentence as // plain text like Yomitan's {sentence}. CardFields.SENTENCE to CardHtml.sentenceFor(model, card), CardFields.IMAGE to (imageHtml ?: ""), CardFields.AUDIO to (audioHtml ?: ""), CardFields.SOURCE to (card.sourceTitle ?: ""), CardFields.WORD_AUDIO to (wordAudioHtml ?: ""), CardFields.PITCH_GRAPH to card.pitchGraphHtml, ) val t2 = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() android.util.Log.i("DSM-Mine", "AnkiDroid: deck/model ${t1 - t0} ms, media ${t2 - t1} ms") val fieldNames = api.getFieldList(modelId)?.toList() ?: CardFields.ORDER val fields = AnkiFieldMapper.mapToArray(fieldNames, values, fieldMap) val tags = card.tags.toSet() if (api.findDuplicateNotes(modelId, card.expression).isNotEmpty()) { return@withContext AnkiResult.Error("Already in Anki") } val t3 = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() // Note: current AnkiDroid API takes (modelId, deckId) in this order. var noteId = api.addNote(modelId = modelId, deckId = deckId, fields = fields, tags = tags) android.util.Log.i("DSM-Mine", "AnkiDroid: fields+duplicate check ${t3 - t2} ms, addNote ${android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - t3} ms") // Some AnkiDroid versions cannot insert notes into a note type that was just // created through the API ("No such notetype" from the Rust backend). NoEmptyFirstLineInClassBody:AnkiFieldMapper.kt:AnkiFieldMapper${ private val aliases: Map> = mapOf( CardFields.EXPRESSION to listOf("expression", "word", "vocab", "vocabulary", "term", "targetword", "key"), CardFields.READING to listOf("reading", "wordreading", "kana", "hiragana", "furigana"), CardFields.MEANING to listOf("meaning", "glossary", "definition", "definitions", "english", "translation", "explanation"), CardFields.SENTENCE to listOf("contextsentence", "sentence", "context", "example", "examplesentence", "sentencejp", "jpsentence"), CardFields.IMAGE to listOf("image", "picture", "snapshot", "screenshot", "photo"), CardFields.AUDIO to listOf("audio", "sentenceaudio", "voice", "sound", "audioclip"), CardFields.SOURCE to listOf("source", "origin", "title", "url"), CardFields.PITCH_GRAPH to listOf("pitchgraph", "graph", "pitchaccentgraph", "pitchaccentgraphs", "pitchaccent", "pitch", "pitchaccents"), CardFields.WORD_AUDIO to listOf("wordaudio", "expressionaudio", "vocabaudio", "vocabularyaudio", "termaudio", "audioword"), ) /** Fields that unambiguously hold the sentence clip (preferred over a plain "Audio"). */ private val sentenceAudioNames = setOf("sentenceaudio", "sentaudio", "audiosentence", "sentencevoice", "sentencesound") private fun normalize(fieldName: String): String = fieldName.lowercase().replace(Regex("[^a-z0-9]"), "") /** canonical field name -> model field name, null when no field matches. */ fun canonicalToModelField(fieldNames: List): Map { val result = mutableMapOf() for (canonical in CardFields.ORDER) { // Aliases are in preference order. Anime Cards: "Context Sentence" is the back-side context; // filling "Sentence" would turn the word card into a sentence card. val match = (aliases[canonical] ?: emptyList()).firstNotNullOfOrNull { alias -> fieldNames.firstOrNull { normalize(it) == alias && it !in result.values } } if (match != null) result[canonical] = match } // "Audio" + "Sentence Audio" (Anime Cards style): Audio is the word, the other the sentence. val sentenceField = fieldNames.firstOrNull { normalize(it) in sentenceAudioNames } if (sentenceField != null) { val plainAudio = fieldNames.firstOrNull { normalize(it) == "audio" } result[CardFields.AUDIO] = sentenceField if (result[CardFields.WORD_AUDIO] == null && plainAudio != null) result[CardFields.WORD_AUDIO] = plainAudio } return result } /** The automatic choice as model field -> canonical field ("" = left empty), for the Fields editor. */ fun automaticAssignment(fieldNames: List): Map { val mapping = canonicalToModelField(fieldNames) return fieldNames.associateWith { name -> mapping.entries.firstOrNull { it.value == name }?.key.orEmpty() } } /** Without a word-audio field the pronunciation rides along in the reading (a play button next to it). */ private fun withWordAudioFallback(mapping: Map, values: Map): Map { val wordAudio = values[CardFields.WORD_AUDIO].orEmpty() if (wordAudio.isBlank() || mapping.containsKey(CardFields.WORD_AUDIO)) return values val host = if (mapping.containsKey(CardFields.READING)) CardFields.READING else CardFields.EXPRESSION return values + (host to (values[host].orEmpty() + " " + wordAudio).trim()) } /** Ordered field values for the AnkiDroid content provider. */ fun mapToArray(fieldNames: List, values: Map, custom: Map? = null): Array { if (custom != null) return fieldNames.map { name -> custom[name]?.let { values[it] }.orEmpty() }.toTypedArray() val mapping = canonicalToModelField(fieldNames) if (mapping.isNotEmpty()) { val filled = withWordAudioFallback(mapping, values) return fieldNames.map { name -> val canonical = mapping.entries.firstOrNull { it.value == name }?.key canonical?.let { filled[it] } ?: "" }.toTypedArray() } if (fieldNames.size == 2) { return twoFieldLayout(values) } return fieldNames.mapIndexed { index, _ -> values[CardFields.ORDER.getOrNull(index)] ?: "" }.toTypedArray() } /** Field name -> value map for AnkiConnect (only fields the model knows about). */ fun mapToNamedFields(fieldNames: List, values: Map, custom: Map? = null): Map { if (custom != null) return fieldNames.associateWith { name -> custom[name]?.let { values[it] }.orEmpty() } val mapping = canonicalToModelField(fieldNames) if (mapping.isNotEmpty()) { val filled = withWordAudioFallback(mapping, values) return mapping.entries.associate { (canonical, modelField) -> modelField to (filled[canonical] ?: "") } } if (fieldNames.size == 2) { val two = twoFieldLayout(values) return fieldNames.mapIndexed { index, name -> name to (two.getOrNull(index) ?: "") }.toMap() } return CardFields.ORDER.mapNotNull { canonical -> values[canonical]?.let { canonical to it } }.toMap() } private fun twoFieldLayout(values: Map): Array { val front = buildString { append("
").append(values[CardFields.EXPRESSION]).append("
") values[CardFields.READING]?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { append("
").append(it).append("
") } values[CardFields.WORD_AUDIO]?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { append(it) } values[CardFields.SENTENCE]?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { append("
").append(it).append("
") } } val back = buildString { values[CardFields.MEANING]?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { append(it).append("
") } values[CardFields.IMAGE]?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { append(it).append("
") } values[CardFields.AUDIO]?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { append(it).append("
") } values[CardFields.SOURCE]?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { append("
").append(it).append("
") } } return arrayOf(front, back) } }

AppRelease) : State data class Downloading(val release: AppRelease, val progress: Float?) : State /** Downloaded; the installer was opened (or needs the "install unknown apps" permission first). */ data class Ready(val release: AppRelease, val apk: File) : State data class Failed(val message: String, val release: AppRelease?) : State } private val _state = MutableStateFlow<State>(State.Idle) val state: StateFlow<State> = _state private val client = OkHttpClient.Builder() .connectTimeout(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS) .readTimeout(120, TimeUnit.SECONDS) .build() @Volatile private var checkedThisRun = false /** Home's automatic check: once per process, release builds only, unless turned off in Settings → About. */ fun checkOnce() { if (!ENABLED || checkedThisRun) return checkedThisRun = true scope.launch { if (prefs.appUpdateCheck.first()) check() } } fun check() { val current = _state.value if (current is State.Checking || current is State.Downloading) return _state.value = State.Checking scope.launch { _state.value = try { val release = latest() when { release == null -> State.Failed("No release APK found on GitHub", null) AppVersion.isNewer(BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME, release.version) -> State.Available(release) else -> State.UpToDate } } catch (e: CancellationException) { throw e } catch (e: Exception) { State.Failed("Could not check for updates: ${e.message}", null) } } } /** Downloads [release] (unless already downloaded) and opens the system installer. */ fun update(release: AppRelease) { val current = _state.value if (current is State.Downloading) return if (current is State.Ready && current.release == release && current.apk.exists()) { install(current.apk) return } _state.value = State.Downloading(release, null) scope.launch { _state.value = try { val apk = download(release) install(apk) State.Ready(release, apk) } catch (e: CancellationException) { throw e } catch (e: Exception) { State.Failed("Download failed: ${e.message}", release) } } } private suspend fun latest(): AppRelease? = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { val request = Request.Builder() .url(LATEST_RELEASE_URL) .header("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json") .header("User-Agent", "DroidSentenceMiner/${BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME}") .build() client.newCall(request).execute().use { response -> if (!response.isSuccessful) throw IllegalStateException("GitHub answered HTTP ${response.code}") parseRelease(response.body?.string().orEmpty()) } } private suspend fun download(release: AppRelease): File = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { val dir = File(context.cacheDir, UPDATE_DIR).apply { mkdirs() } // Only the newest download is kept. dir.listFiles()?.forEach { it.delete() } val apk = File(dir, "droid-sentence-miner-${release.tag}.apk") val request = Request.Builder().url(release.apkUrl).header("User-Agent", "DroidSentenceMiner").build() try { client.newCall(request).execute().use { response -> if (!response.isSuccessful) throw IllegalStateException("HTTP ${response.code}") val body = response.body ?: throw IllegalStateException("empty response") val total = body.contentLength().takeIf { it > 0 } ?: release.apkSize.takeIf { it > 0 } var done = 0L var lastReport = 0L body.byteStream().use { input -> apk.outputStream().use { output -> val buffer = ByteArray(64 * 1024) while (true) { val read = input.read(buffer) if (read < 0) break output.write(buffer, 0, read) done += read if (done - lastReport > 512 * 1024) { lastReport = done _state.value = State.Downloading(release, total?.let { done.toFloat() / it }) } } } } } } catch (e: Exception) { apk.delete() throw e } apk } /** * Hands [apk] to the system installer. Without the "install unknown apps" permission the * system's page for it opens instead; tapping Update again afterwards installs. */ fun install(apk: File) { if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26 && !context.packageManager.canRequestPackageInstalls()) { val intent = Intent(Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_UNKNOWN_APP_SOURCES, Uri.parse("package:${context.packageName}")) .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK) context.startActivity(intent) return } val uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(context, "${context.packageName}.files", apk) val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW) .setDataAndType(uri, APK_MIME) .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK) context.startActivity(intent) } companion object { /** Debug builds are versioned 0.1.0 locally and signed with another key: never offer them a release. */ val ENABLED = !BuildConfig.DEBUG const val LATEST_RELEASE_URL = "https://api.github.com/repos/WilsonNet/droid-sentence-miner/releases/latest" private const val UPDATE_DIR = "updates" private const val APK_MIME = "application/vnd.android.package-archive" /** GitHub's `releases/latest` JSON → the release and its `.apk` asset (null without one). */ fun parseRelease(json: String): AppRelease? { val root = JSONObject(json) val tag = root.optString("tag_name").ifBlank { return null } val assets = root.optJSONArray("assets") ?: return null for (i in 0 until assets.length()) { val asset = assets.getJSONObject(i) if (asset.optString("name").endsWith(".apk", ignoreCase = true)) { return AppRelease( version = tag.removePrefix("v"), tag = tag, apkUrl = asset.getString("browser_download_url"), apkSize = asset.optLong("size"), notes = root.optString("body"), pageUrl = root.optString("html_url"), ) } } return null } } }

downY).coerceIn(-startBox.top, height - startBox.bottom), ) } Mode.RESIZE_TL -> { box.left = min(x, box.right - min); box.top = min(y, box.bottom - min) } Mode.RESIZE_TR -> { box.right = max(x, box.left + min); box.top = min(y, box.bottom - min) } Mode.RESIZE_BL -> { box.left = min(x, box.right - min); box.bottom = max(y, box.top + min) } Mode.RESIZE_BR -> { box.right = max(x, box.left + min); box.bottom = max(y, box.top + min) } Mode.CREATE -> box.set(min(downX, x), min(downY, y), max(downX, x), max(downY, y)) Mode.NONE -> Unit } box.intersect(0f, 0f, width.toFloat(), NoEmptyFirstLineInClassBody:M4aEncoder.kt:M4aEncoder${ data class EncodedAudio(val bytes: ByteArray, val extension: String, val mimeType: String) fun encode(segment: AudioSegment, outputFile: File, bitRate: Int = 96_000): EncodedAudio? { val mono = AudioPcm.downmixToMono(segment) val aac = runCatching { encodeAac(mono, outputFile, bitRate) }.getOrNull() if (aac != null) { return EncodedAudio(aac.readBytes(), "m4a", "audio/mp4") } // Fallback to WAV, which Anki always accepts. val wavFile = File(outputFile.parentFile, outputFile.nameWithoutExtension + ".wav") runCatching { wavFile.writeBytes(WavEncoder.encode(mono)) }.getOrNull() ?: return null return EncodedAudio(wavFile.readBytes(), "wav", "audio/wav") } private fun encodeAac(segment: AudioSegment, outputFile: File, bitRate: Int): File { val format = MediaFormat.createAudioFormat(MediaFormat.MIMETYPE_AUDIO_AAC, segment.sampleRate, 1).apply { setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_AAC_PROFILE, MediaCodecInfo.CodecProfileLevel.AACObjectLC) setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_BIT_RATE, bitRate) setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_MAX_INPUT_SIZE, 16384) } val codec = MediaCodec.createEncoderByType(MediaFormat.MIMETYPE_AUDIO_AAC) codec.configure(format, null, null, MediaCodec.CONFIGURE_FLAG_ENCODE) codec.start() val muxer = MediaMuxer(outputFile.absolutePath, MediaMuxer.OutputFormat.MUXER_OUTPUT_MPEG_4) var trackIndex = -1 var muxerStarted = false val bufferInfo = MediaCodec.BufferInfo() val bytes = ByteBuffer.allocate(segment.pcm.size * 2).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN) for (sample in segment.pcm) bytes.putShort(sample) bytes.flip() val chunkSize = 4096 * 2 var inputDone = false var outputDone = false val deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + 20_000 while (!outputDone) { if (System.currentTimeMillis() > deadline) { throw IllegalStateException("AAC encoding timed out") } if (!inputDone) { val inputIndex = codec.dequeueInputBuffer(10_000) if (inputIndex >= 0) { val inputBuffer = codec.getInputBuffer(inputIndex)!! inputBuffer.clear() val totalBytes = segment.pcm.size * 2 val consumedBefore = totalBytes - bytes.remaining() val size = minOf(bytes.remaining(), chunkSize) if (size > 0) { val chunk = ByteArray(size) bytes.get(chunk) inputBuffer.put(chunk) } val presentationTimeUs = 1_000_000L * (consumedBefore / 2) / segment.sampleRate if (bytes.remaining() == 0) { codec.queueInputBuffer(inputIndex, 0, size, presentationTimeUs, MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM) inputDone = true } else { codec.queueInputBuffer(inputIndex, 0, size, presentationTimeUs, 0) } } } when (val outputIndex = codec.dequeueOutputBuffer(bufferInfo, 10_000)) { MediaCodec.INFO_TRY_AGAIN_LATER -> Unit MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED -> { trackIndex = muxer.addTrack(codec.outputFormat) muxer.start() muxerStarted = true } else -> { if (outputIndex >= 0) { val outputBuffer = codec.getOutputBuffer(outputIndex)!! if (bufferInfo.flags and MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_CODEC_CONFIG != 0) { bufferInfo.size = 0 } if (bufferInfo.size > 0 && muxerStarted) { outputBuffer.position(bufferInfo.offset) outputBuffer.limit(bufferInfo.offset + bufferInfo.size) muxer.writeSampleData(trackIndex, outputBuffer, bufferInfo) } codec.releaseOutputBuffer(outputIndex, false) if (bufferInfo.flags and MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM != 0) { outputDone = true } } } } } codec.stop() codec.release() if (muxerStarted) muxer.stop() muxer.release() return outputFile } }

candCenter) > max(avgHeight * 0.55f, 10f)) return false val horizontalGap = when { candidate.box.left >= ref.box.right -> candidate.box.left - ref.box.right ref.box.left >= candidate.box.right -> ref.box.left - candidate.box.right else -> 0 } val allowedGap = max(avgHeight * 0.9f, 24f) return horizontalGap <= allowedGap } /** * A conservative furigana heuristic: kana-only lines that are much smaller than * the median line and overlap a taller line horizontally are dropped. */ private fun dropFurigana(lines: List<OcrLine>): List<OcrLine> { if (lines.size < 2) return lines val heights = lines.map { it.box.height.toFloat() }.sorted() val median = heights[heights.size / 2] if (median <= 0f) return lines return lines.filterNot { line -> val height = line.box.height val isSmall = height < median * 0.62f val isKanaOnly = line.text.all { Languages.current.isRubyChar(it) } val overlapsTaller = lines.any { other -> other !== line && other.box.height > height * 1.4f && horizontalOverlap(line.box, other.box) > 0.3f } isSmall && isKanaOnly && overlapsTaller && line.text.length <= 10 } } private fun horizontalOverlap(a: BoundingBox, b: BoundingBox): Float { val overlap = (min(a.right, b.right) - max(a.left, b.left)).toFloat() val minWidth = min(a.width, b.width).toFloat() if (minWidth <= 0f) return 0f return (overlap / minWidth).coerceIn(0f, 1f) } private fun japaneseRatio(text: String): Float { var significant = 0 var japanese = 0 for (ch in text) { if (ch.isLetterOrDigit()) { significant++ if (Languages.current.isTargetChar(ch)) japanese++ } } return if (significant == 0) 0f else japanese.toFloat() / significant } private fun joinRows(parts: List<String>): String = parts.fold("") { acc, part -> Languages.current.joinRows(acc, part) }.trim() /** OCR text normalization for the study language (NFKC, punctuation, spacing). */ fun normalize(text: String): String = Languages.current.normalizeOcr(text) }

NoEmptyFirstLineInClassBody:OcrTextFixes.kt:OcrTextFixes${ // After kana, 一 is still the numeral before counters/nouns like these (もう一つ, お一人, もう一度). private const val NUMERAL_FOLLOWERS = "つ人度番日回緒生方本杯枚個歩部員口切息時線気応発年月週階台匹冊通見瞬層般体同定心途段帯面律連斉家円万億千百十品着軒件曲話球点戦歳言粒滴羽頭杯筋瞥撃目端角睡周晩夜" fun apply(text: String): String = katakanaE(longVowelMarks(text)) /** ML Kit reads the katakana エ as a Latin H in vertical text (Hリート, Hーダイ). */ fun katakanaE(text: String): String { if ('H' !in text && 'Ｈ' !in text) return text val chars = text.toCharArray() for (i in chars.indices) { if (chars[i] != 'H' && chars[i] != 'Ｈ') continue val next = chars.getOrNull(i + 1) ?: continue if (next == 'ー' || next.code in 0x30A1..0x30FA) chars[i] = 'エ' } return String(chars) } /** 一 (kanji "one") right after kana is almost always the long-vowel mark ー (おー, わー, メニュー). */ fun longVowelMarks(text: String): String { if ('一' !in text) return text val chars = text.toCharArray() for (i in chars.indices) { if (chars[i] != '一' || i == 0) continue if (!isKana(chars[i - 1])) continue val next = chars.getOrNull(i + 1) if (next != null && next in NUMERAL_FOLLOWERS) continue chars[i] = 'ー' } return String(chars) } private fun isKana(c: Char) = c.code in 0x3041..0x3096 || c.code in 0x30A1..0x30FA }

}, onDragEnd = { saveLiveWindowPosition() }, onResize = { dx, dy -> resizeLiveWindow(dx, dy) }, onResizeEnd = { val (w, h) = liveSizeDp val landscape = liveLandscape() scope.launch { density = resources.displayMetrics.density val position = container.prefs.liveWindowPosition(landscape).first() ?: ((12 * density).roundToInt() to (40 * density).roundToInt()) liveSizeDp = 1, prob, label, queue, tail, thresh, next) if (x < width - 1) tail = visit(p + 1, prob, label, queue, tail, thresh, next) if (y > 0) tail = visit(p - width, prob, label, queue, tail, thresh, next) if (y < height - 1) tail = visit(p + width, prob, label, queue, tail, thresh, next) } val w = maxX - minX + 1 val h = maxY - minY + 1 if (min(w, h) < 3) continue val score = (sum / tail).toFloat() if (score < boxThresh) continue val distance = w.toFloat() * h * unclipRatio / (2f * (w + h)) val d = ceil(distance).toInt() out += MapBox( left = max(0, minX - d), top = max(0, minY - d), right = min(width, maxX + 1 + d), bottom = min(height, maxY + 1 + d), score = score, ) if (out.size >= maxCandidates) break } return out } private fun visit(p: Int, prob: FloatArray, label: IntArray, queue: IntArray, tail: Int, thresh: Float, id: Int): Int { if (label[p] != 0 || prob[p] <= thresh) return tail label[p] = id queue[tail] = p return tail + 1 } /** * Greedy CTC decode of one line's `[timesteps × classes]` scores ([classes] per row). Class 0 is * the blank, class i the dictionary's (i − 1)th entry, the last class a space. Repeats collapse. */ fun ctcDecode(scores: FloatArray, timesteps: Int, classes: Int, dictionary: List<String>): List<Glyph> { val glyphs = ArrayList<Glyph>() var prev = 0 var t = 0 while (t < timesteps) { val row = t * classes var best = 0 var bestScore = scores[row] for (c in 1 until classes) { val s = scores[row + c] if (s > bestScore) { best = c bestScore = s } } if (best != 0 && best != prev) { glyphs += Glyph(charOf(best, dictionary), bestScore, t, t + 1) } else if (best != 0 && glyphs.isNotEmpty()) { val last = glyphs.last() glyphs[glyphs.lastIndex] = last.copy(end = t + 1) } prev = best t++ } return glyphs } private fun charOf(index: Int, dictionary: List<String>): String = if (index - 1 < dictionary.size) dictionary[index - 1] else " " /** * Reads a PaddleOCR recognizer dictionary: one character per line (a `ppocr_keys`-style * `dict.txt`), or the `character_dict:` list of an exported `inference.yml`. */ fun parseDictionary(text: String): List<String> { if (!text.contains("character_dict:")) return text.split('\n').map { it.removeSuffix("\r") }.dropLastWhile { it.isEmpty() } val lines = text.lines() val start = lines.indexOfFirst { it.trimStart().startsWith("character_dict:") } val indent = lines[start].indexOfFirst { !it.isWhitespace() } val out = ArrayList<String>() for (line in lines.drop(start + 1)) { val trimmed = line.trimStart() val lineIndent = line.length - trimmed.length if (!trimmed.startsWith("- ") && trimmed != "-") { if (lineIndent <= indent) break else continue } out += yamlScalar(trimmed.removePrefix("-").removePrefix(" ")) } return out } /** The YAML scalars PaddleOCR's exporter writes: plain, 'single' ('' escapes ') or "double" (\ escapes). */ private fun yamlScalar(raw: String): String = when { raw.length >= 2 && raw.startsWith("'") && raw.endsWith("'") -> raw.substring(1, raw.length - 1).replace("''", "'") raw.length >= 2 && raw.startsWith("\"") && raw.endsWith("\"") -> unescape(raw.substring(1, raw.length - 1)) else -> raw } private fun unescape(s: String): String { val sb = StringBuilder() var i = 0 while (i < s.length) { val c = s[i] if (c == '\\' && i + 1 < s.length) { val n = s[i + 1] when (n) { 'n' -> sb.append('\n') 't' -> sb.append('\t') 'u' -> if (i + 5 < s.length) { sb.append(s.substring(i + 2, i + 6).toInt(16).toChar()) i += 4 } 'x' -> if (i + 3 < s.length) { sb.append(s.substring(i + 2, i + 4).toInt(16).toChar()) i += 2 } else -> sb.append(n) } i += 2 } else { sb.append(c) i++ } } return sb.toString() } }

left val height: Float get() = bottom - top fun toRect(screenW: Int, screenH: Int): Rect = Rect( (left * screenW).toInt(), (top * screenH).toInt(), (right * screenW).toInt(), (bottom * screenH).toInt(), ) } companion object { private const val MIN_ACQUIRE_INTERVAL_MS = 100L fun screenMetrics(context: Context): DisplayMetrics { val metrics = DisplayMetrics() if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) { val wm = context.getSystemService(WindowManager::class.java) val bounds = wm.currentWindowMetrics.bounds metrics.widthPixels = bounds.width() metrics.heightPixels = bounds.height() metrics.densityDpi = context.resources.configuration.densityDpi } else { @Suppress("DEPRECATION") val wm = context.getSystemService(Context.WINDOW_SERVICE) as WindowManager @Suppress("DEPRECATION") wm.defaultDisplay.getRealMetrics(metrics) } return metrics } } }

slackX || x > g.right + slackX || y < g.top - slackY || y > g.bottom + slackY) return@forEachIndexed val d = (g.centerX - x) * (g.centerX - x) + (g.centerY - y) * (g.centerY - y) if (d < bestDistance) { bestDistance = d best = l to i } } } return best } }

NoEmptyFirstLineInClassBody:SubtitleLineFilter.kt:SubtitleLineFilter${ fun filter(lines: List<OcrPostProcessor.MergedLine>): List<OcrPostProcessor.MergedLine> { if (lines.size <= 1) return lines val dialogue = lines.filter { japaneseCount(it.text) >= MIN_JAPANESE } if (dialogue.isEmpty()) return lines // The longest Japanese row anchors the expected glyph height. val anchor = dialogue.maxBy { japaneseCount(it.text) }.box.height.toFloat() if (anchor <= 0f) return lines return lines.filter { line -> val ratio = line.box.height / anchor japaneseCount(line.text) >= MIN_JAPANESE && ratio in MIN_HEIGHT_RATIO..MAX_HEIGHT_RATIO } } /** * Drops engine lines read with very low confidence while another line in the same read is * sure: a burned-in subtitle half hidden under a caption box comes back as garbage (0.27 next * to 0.97) and would be glued onto the clean line. NoEmptyFirstLineInClassBody:TextLineTracker.kt:ClipWindow${ data class Bounds(val startMs: Long, val endMs: Long) fun compute( lineStartMs: Long, lineEndMs: Long?, nextStartMs: Long?, nowMs: Long, beforeMs: Long, afterMs: Long, maxLengthMs: Long = 30_000, ): Bounds { val end = listOfNotNull(lineEndMs, nextStartMs).minOrNull() ?: nowMs val start = lineStartMs - beforeMs val clipEnd = minOf(end + afterMs, nowMs, start + maxLengthMs) return Bounds(start, maxOf(clipEnd, start)) } }

NoEmptyFirstLineInClassBody:TextLineTracker.kt:TextSimilarity${ private val ignorable = Regex("[\\s\\p{Punct}、。・「」『』（）()【】…‥！？!?ー〜~♪]") private val boxEdges = Regex("^[|｜│¦\\[\\]]+|[|｜│¦\\[\\]]+$") /** Normalizes OCR output for comparison and storage (joins lines, drops caption-box edges). */ fun clean(text: String): String { val rows = text.lines().map { it.trim().replace(boxEdges, "").trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() } val out = StringBuilder() for (row in rows) { // Japanese wraps without spaces (one is kept between Latin words); spaced languages get one. if (out.isEmpty()) { out.append(row) } else if (Languages.current.usesSpaces) { val joined = Languages.current.joinRows(out.toString(), row) out.setLength(0) out.append(joined) } else { if (out.last().isLatinOrDigit() && row.first().isLatinOrDigit()) out.append(' ') out.append(row) } } return out.toString() } private fun Char.isLatinOrDigit() = this in 'a'..'z' || this in 'A'..'Z' || this in '0'..'9' /** * The read with the smallest total edit distance to all reads (a medoid). OCR errors are * mostly independent per read, so this lands on the reading most reads agree with. */ fun consensus(reads: List<String>): String { val counts = reads.groupingBy { it }.eachCount() return counts.keys.minWith( compareBy<String> { candidate -> counts.entries.sumOf { (read, n) -> n * levenshtein(candidate, read) } } .thenByDescending { counts.getValue(it) }, ) } /** 1.0 = identical (ignoring spacing/punctuation), 0.0 = nothing in common. */ fun ratio(a: String, b: String): Double { val x = a.replace(ignorable, "") val y = b.replace(ignorable, "") if (x.isEmpty() && y.isEmpty()) return 1.0 if (x.isEmpty() || y.isEmpty()) return 0.0 val distance = levenshtein(x, y) return 1.0 - distance.toDouble() / maxOf(x.length, y.length) } private fun levenshtein(a: String, b: String): Int { var prev = IntArray(b.length + 1) { it } var cur = IntArray(b.length + 1) for (i in 1..a.length) { cur[0] = i for (j in 1..b.length) { val cost = if (a[i - 1] == b[j - 1]) 0 else 1 cur[j] = minOf(cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j] + 1, prev[j - 1] + cost) } val t = prev prev = cur cur = t } return prev[b.length] } }

NoEmptyFirstLineInClassBody:VoiceTrimmer.kt:VoiceTrimmer${ data class Result(val segment: AudioSegment, val startMs: Long, val endMs: Long, val trimmed: Boolean) fun trim( segment: AudioSegment, windowMs: Int = 20, minSpeechMs: Int = 120, smoothMs: Int = 160, padStartMs: Int = 300, padEndMs: Int = 500, absoluteFloor: Double = 180.0, /** Share of the noise → peak gap a window must clear. */ relativeThreshold: Double = 0.05, /** * Null: speech ends at the last loud run in the clip. Otherwise it ends at the last run * reached from the first one through silences of at most this long, so a sound well after * the line (a door, a cough, the next scene's music) doesn't stretch it. */ maxGapMs: Int? = null, ): Result { val mono = AudioPcm.downmixToMono(segment) val windowFrames = (mono.sampleRate * windowMs / 1000).coerceAtLeast(1) val windows = mono.frameCount / windowFrames val untouched = Result(segment, 0, segment.durationMs, trimmed = false) if (windows < 3) return untouched val energies = DoubleArray(windows) { w -> var sum = 0.0 val base = w * windowFrames for (i in base until base + windowFrames) { val v = mono.pcm[i].toDouble() sum += v * v } sqrt(sum / windowFrames) } val sorted = energies.sorted() val noise = sorted[(sorted.size * 0.2).toInt()] val peak = sorted[(sorted.size * 0.98).toInt().coerceAtMost(sorted.size - 1)] if (peak < absoluteFloor) return untouched val threshold = maxOf(absoluteFloor, noise * 2.0, noise + (peak - noise) * relativeThreshold) val smoothed = smooth(energies, (smoothMs / windowMs).coerceAtLeast(1)) val minRun = (minSpeechMs / windowMs).coerceAtLeast(1) val first = firstRun(smoothed, threshold, minRun, forward = true) ?: return untouched val last = if (maxGapMs == null) { firstRun(smoothed, threshold, minRun, forward = false) ?: return untouched } else { lastConnectedWindow(smoothed, threshold, minRun, first, (maxGapMs / windowMs).coerceAtLeast(1)) } val startMs = (first.toLong() * windowMs - padStartMs).coerceAtLeast(0) val endMs = ((last + 1).toLong() * windowMs + padEndMs).coerceAtMost(segment.durationMs) if (endMs - startMs < 250) return untouched val sliced = AudioPcm.trim(segment, startMs, endMs) ?: return untouched return Result(AudioPcm.fadeEdges(sliced), startMs, endMs, trimmed = startMs > 0 || endMs < segment.durationMs) } /** Last loud window of the runs (≥ [minRun]) chained from [start] with gaps ≤ [maxGap] windows. */ private fun lastConnectedWindow(energies: DoubleArray, threshold: Double, minRun: Int, start: Int, maxGap: Int): Int { var end = start var i = start while (i < energies.size) { if (energies[i] < threshold) { i++ continue } var j = i while (j < energies.size && energies[j] >= threshold) j++ if (j - i >= minRun) { if (i - end > maxGap && end > start) break end = j - 1 } i = j } return end } /** Centered moving average. */ private fun smooth(values: DoubleArray, width: Int): DoubleArray { if (width <= 1) return values val half = width / 2 return DoubleArray(values.size) { i -> val from = (i - half).coerceAtLeast(0) val to = (i - half + width).coerceAtMost(values.size) var sum = 0.0 for (j in from until to) sum += values[j] sum / (to - from) } } /** Index of the outermost window that starts (or ends) a run of [minRun] loud windows. */ private fun firstRun(energies: DoubleArray, threshold: Double, minRun: Int, forward: Boolean): Int? { val indices = if (forward) energies.indices else energies.indices.reversed() var run = 0 var runStart = -1 for (i in indices) { if (energies[i] >= threshold) { if (run == 0) runStart = i run++ if (run >= minRun) return runStart } else { run = 0 } } return null } }

NoEmptyFirstLineInClassBody:WavEncoder.kt:WavEncoder${ fun encode(segment: AudioSegment): ByteArray { val pcm = segment.pcm val dataSize = pcm.size * 2 val out = ByteArrayOutputStream(44 + dataSize) val byteRate = segment.sampleRate * segment.channels * 2 val blockAlign = segment.channels * 2 out.write("RIFF".toByteArray()) out.write(intLe(36 + dataSize)) out.write("WAVE".toByteArray()) out.write("fmt ".toByteArray()) out.write(intLe(16)) out.write(shortLe(1)) // PCM out.write(shortLe(segment.channels)) out.write(intLe(segment.sampleRate)) out.write(intLe(byteRate)) out.write(shortLe(blockAlign)) out.write(shortLe(16)) out.write("data".toByteArray()) out.write(intLe(dataSize)) for (sample in pcm) { out.write(sample.toInt() and 0xFF) out.write((sample.toInt() shr 8) and 0xFF) } return out.toByteArray() } private fun intLe(value: Int): ByteArray = byteArrayOf( (value and 0xFF).toByte(), ((value shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte(), ((value shr 16) and 0xFF).toByte(), ((value shr 24) and 0xFF).toByte(), ) private fun shortLe(value: Int): ByteArray = byteArrayOf( (value and 0xFF).toByte(), ((value shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte(), ) }

NoEmptyFirstLineInClassBody:WordAudio.kt:WordAudio${ data class Clip(val bytes: ByteArray, val extension: String, val source: String) /** * The first valid clip from the sources in Yomitan's order. Gives up after [budgetMs] in total: * a word with no audio anywhere tries every source, and a slow site held the card for 15+ s. */ suspend fun fetch(term: String, reading: String, customUrl: String? = null, budgetMs: Long = BUDGET_MS): Clip? = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + budgetMs val read = reading.ifBlank { term } val attempts = buildList<Pair<String, () -> List<String>>> { customUrl?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { template -> add("custom" to { listOf(WordAudioSources.customUrl(template, term, read)) }) } val language = io.github.wilsonnet.droidsentenceminer.lang.Languages.current if (language.japaneseWordAudio) { add("jpod101" to { listOf(WordAudioSources.jpod101Url(term, read)) }) add("languagepod101" to { languagePod101(term, read) }) add("jisho" to { jisho(term, read) }) } else { // Yomitan's source for other languages: Wiktionary's recordings on Wikimedia Commons. add("wiktionary" to { wiktionary(language.code, term) }) } } for ((source, urls) in attempts) { if (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() > deadline) break val candidates = runCatching { urls() }.getOrDefault(emptyList()) for (url in candidates) { if (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() > deadline) break val bytes = runCatching { download(url) }.getOrNull() ?: continue if (!WordAudioSources.isValid(source, bytes)) continue return@withContext Clip(bytes, WordAudioSources.extension(url), source) } } null } private fun download(url: String): ByteArray? { val request = Request.Builder().url(url) // Wikimedia answers 403 to clients that don't identify themselves (okhttp's default agent). if (url.contains("wikimedia.org")) request.header("User-Agent", COMMONS_UA) client.newCall(request.build()).execute().use { response -> if (!response.isSuccessful) return null val type = response.header("Content-Type").orEmpty() if (type.startsWith("text/")) return null return response.body?.bytes() } } private fun languagePod101(term: String, reading: String): List<String> { val body = FormBody.Builder() .add("post", "dictionary_reference") .add("match_type", "exact") .add("search_query", term) .add("vulgar", "true") .build() val request = Request.Builder() .url("https://www.japanesepod101.com/learningcenter/reference/dictionary_post") .post(body) .build() val html = client.newCall(request).execute().use { it.body?.string().orEmpty() } return WordAudioSources.parseLanguagePod101(html, term, reading) } /** Commons files named `En-us-word.ogg`, `En-uk-word.ogg`… (Yomitan's wiktionary source), US first. */ private fun wiktionary(language: String, term: String): List<String> { val search = commonsJson(WordAudioSources.commonsSearchUrl(language, term)) ?: return emptyList() val titles = WordAudioSources.parseCommonsTitles(search, language, term).take(4) if (titles.isEmpty()) return emptyList() val info = commonsJson(WordAudioSources.commonsInfoUrl(titles)) ?: return emptyList() return WordAudioSources.parseCommonsUrls(info, titles) } private fun commonsJson(url: String): String? = client.newCall(Request.Builder().url(url).header("User-Agent", COMMONS_UA).build()).execute().use { r -> if (r.isSuccessful) r.body?.string() else null } private fun jisho(term: String, reading: String): List<String> { val url = "https://jisho.org/search/" + URLEncoder.encode(term, "UTF-8").replace("+", "%20") val html = client.newCall(Request.Builder().url(url).build()).execute().use { it.body?.string().orEmpty() } return listOfNotNull(WordAudioSources.parseJisho(html, term, reading)) } companion object { /** Wikimedia asks API clients to identify themselves. */ private const val COMMONS_UA = "DroidSentenceMiner/1.0 (https://github.com/WilsonNet/droid-sentence-miner)" /** Total time a card waits for word audio; it is added without it after that. */ const val BUDGET_MS = 8_000L private val defaultClient: OkHttpClient by lazy { OkHttpClient.Builder() .connectTimeout(4, TimeUnit.SECONDS) .readTimeout(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS) // One request can't outlast the budget by much. .callTimeout(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS) .followRedirects(true) .build() } } }

NoEmptyFirstLineInClassBody:WordAudio.kt:WordAudioSources${ /** SHA-256 of JapanesePod101's "this audio is not available" clip (same constant as Yomitan). */ private const val JPOD101_INVALID = "ae6398b5a27bc8c0a771df6c907ade794be15518174773c58c7c7ddd17098906" fun jpod101Url(term: String, reading: String): String { // Kana-only words are looked up by reading alone, like Yomitan. val kanaOnly = term == reading && term.all { isKana(it) } val params = buildList { if (!kanaOnly && term.isNotEmpty()) add("kanji=" + enc(term)) if (reading.isNotEmpty()) add("kana=" + enc(reading)) } return "https://assets.languagepod101.com/dictionary/japanese/audiomp3.php?" + params.joinToString("&") } fun customUrl(template: String, term: String, reading: String): String = template.replace("{term}", enc(term)).replace("{reading}", enc(reading)).replace("{language}", "ja") /** Audio URLs of result rows whose reading matches (`dc-result-row` / `dc-vocab_kana`). */ fun parseLanguagePod101(html: String, term: String, reading: String): List<String> { val urls = LinkedHashSet<String>() // Rows are `class="... dc-result-row"`; don't split on `dc-result-row__checkbox` etc. for (row in html.split(Regex("class=\"[^\"]*\\bdc-result-row(?=[\\s\"])")).drop(1)) { val src = Regex("<source[^>]+src=\"([^\"]+)\"").find(row)?.groupValues?.get(1) ?: continue val kana = Regex("dc-vocab_kana[^>]*>([^<]*)<").find(row)?.groupValues?.get(1)?.trim() ?: continue if (reading != term && kana != reading) continue urls += absolute(src, "https://www.japanesepod101.com") } return urls.toList() } /** Jisho marks audio as `<audio id="audio_{term}:{reading}"><source src=...>`. */ fun parseJisho(html: String, term: String, reading: String): String? { val start = html.indexOf("id=\"audio_$term:$reading\"").takeIf { it >= 0 } ?: return null val src = Regex("<source[^>]+src=\"([^\"]+)\"").find(html, start)?.groupValues?.get(1) ?: return null return absolute(src, "https://jisho.org") } fun isValid(source: String, bytes: ByteArray): Boolean { if (bytes.size < 1_000) return false if (source == "jpod101" && sha256(bytes) == JPOD101_INVALID) return false return true } /** Commons full-text search for `<Lang>(-xx)?-<term>N.ogg` file names (Yomitan's query). */ fun commonsSearchUrl(language: String, term: String): String { val prefix = language.replaceFirstChar { it.uppercaseChar() } val pattern = "intitle:/$prefix(-[a-z]{2})?-${escapeRegex(term)}[0-9]*\\.ogg/i" return "https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&format=json&list=search&srnamespace=6&srlimit=10&srsearch=" + URLEncoder.encode(pattern, "UTF-8") } private fun escapeRegex(text: String): String = buildString { text.forEach { c -> if (c.isLetterOrDigit() || c == ' ') append(c) else append('\\').append(c) } } /** * File titles from a Commons search that really are [term] in [language] (the search is fuzzy), * US recordings first, then UK, then the rest. */ fun parseCommonsTitles(json: String, language: String, term: String): List<String> { val root = runCatching { Json.parseToJsonElement(json).jsonObject }.getOrNull() ?: return emptyList() val hits = (root["query"] as? JsonObject)?.get("search") as? JsonArray ?: return emptyList() val exact = Regex("File:${Regex.escape(language)}(-[a-z]{2})?-${Regex.escape(term)}[0-9]*\\.ogg", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE) val titles = hits.mapNotNull { ((it as? JsonObject)?.get("title") as? JsonPrimitive)?.content }.filter { exact.matches(it) } fun rank(t: String) = when { t.contains("-us-", ignoreCase = true) -> 0 t.contains("-uk-", ignoreCase = true) -> 1 else -> 2 } return titles.sortedBy { rank(it) } } fun commonsInfoUrl(titles: List<String>): String = "https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&format=json&prop=imageinfo&iiprop=url&titles=" + URLEncoder.encode(titles.joinToString("|"), "UTF-8") /** Download URLs from a Commons imageinfo answer, in [titles] order. */ fun parseCommonsUrls(json: String, titles: List<String>): List<String> { val root = runCatching { Json.parseToJsonElement(json).jsonObject }.getOrNull() ?: return emptyList() val pages = (root["query"] as? JsonObject)?.get("pages") as? JsonObject ?: return emptyList() val byTitle = HashMap<String, String>() for (page in pages.values) { val o = page as? JsonObject ?: continue val info = (o["imageinfo"] as? JsonArray)?.firstOrNull() as? JsonObject ?: continue val url = (info["url"] as? JsonPrimitive)?.content ?: continue byTitle[title] = url } return titles.mapNotNull { byTitle[it] } } fun extension(url: String): String = url.substringBefore('?').substringAfterLast('.', "mp3").lowercase().takeIf { it in setOf("mp3", "ogg", "opus", "m4a", "wav", "aac") } ?: "mp3" private fun absolute(src: String, base: String): String = when { src.startsWith("//") -> "https:$src" src.startsWith("/") -> base + src else -> src } private fun sha256(bytes: ByteArray): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) } private fun enc(s: String) = URLEncoder.encode(s, "UTF-8").replace("+", "%20") private fun isKana(c: Char) = c.code in 0x3041..0x309F || c.code in 0x30A0..0x30FF }
